lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You sure that she wasn't taken out to the garage alive and some of the stuff was done to her out there?

lines.text: Hanging from a rafter, 'er anything like that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Now the worst is over, you're not gonna shock us or anything by tellin' us if that happened. Cuz I-I just have a feeling that something may, may be there. Talk to me.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: It all happened in the bedroom you said. (Brendan nods "yes") You're positive of that.

lines.text: Keep in mind that you know, Steven's gonna have his time to tell his story too. Right?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: He's not gonna say anything different?

lines.text: Did you turn the mattress over or anything like that?

lines.text: The cleaning of the house, w-ah Brendan, did, did a Steven do some cleaning in the house?
